info.name: Material Designer — daemon API
info.description:
HTTP API exposed by the Material Designer **daemon** (`apps/daemon`), the local privileged process that owns projects, agent runs, skills, design systems, plugins, artifacts and static serving. The web UI and the `od` CLI are both clients of these same endpoints.

**The daemon binds to loopback (`127.0.0.1`) by default and listens on port `7456`.** It is a local service, not a hosted one: there is no multi-tenant auth layer, and a number of endpoints are additionally gated behind a local-origin / local-daemon check that fails when the daemon is bound to a non-loopback address. Treat the whole surface as trusted-local, and do not expose it to a network.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if you run the daemon on another port.

Endpoints that stream Server-Sent Events are marked **"SSE stream."** at the start of their description and carry an `Accept: text/event-stream` header.

This collection is generated by reading the daemon route definitions in `apps/daemon/src/server.ts`, `apps/daemon/src/routes/**` and `apps/daemon/src/*-routes.ts`. See `postman/README.md` for how to verify or regenerate it.
